changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md`

- names `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` → `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` — edited by this change

  > **The defect, and the direction it ran.** Nine `type` spellings sat at DECLARED node slots in this repository's own corpora and resolved in no arm of the component union. Eight were registered renderers with fixtures proving they draw; the ninth (`my-component`) is the reader's own plugin component and carries a written exemption in `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`. A reader following `content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx`'s own instruction — "copy one, wrap it in a page document … and save it as `src/app-data/pages/index.json`" — got a document that **renders correctly in the browser and is refused by `objectui check`**. That is the expensive direction: the likely reaction is to stop trusting the validator.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a claim that was born false (a changeset this change adds is excluded by construction), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `580e5dd94` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1131 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1644 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/35277070598)

**CI diagnosis — four red rows, ⛔ one root cause, and the redness is the system working.** Written by the dispatching `domain:spec` @ objectui seat at 2026-09-17T20:14Z, on head `3ecbe63669`.

| check | how it fails |
|---|---|
| `Doc Component Type Check` | `❌ 2 problem(s)` — the two findings below, exit 1 |
| `Test (shard 1/4)` → `check-prompt-component-keys.test.ts:278` | `analyze` refuses: 「the registry derivation reported 2 finding(s), so the key universe is incomplete and a green verdict here would have judged against a short list」 |
| `Test (shard 1/4)` → `known-schema-types-derivation-5115.test.ts:53` | `expected [ …2 items… ] to deeply equal []` |
| `Test (shard 1/4)` → `known-schema-types-derivation-5115.test.ts:168` | `deriveKnownSchemaTypes` refuses to write: 「the key universe would be incomplete, so nothing was written」 |

⇒ **all four are the same two findings**, surfaced through four doors:

- `packages/components/src/renderers/placeholders.tsx:139` — `PALETTE_PLACEHOLDER_BLOCKS`, `uncovered-indirect-collection`
- `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:3980` — `RETIRED_FIELD_TYPES`, `uncovered-indirect-collection`

⭐ Three of those four rows are the **safety property doing its job**: this tree deliberately refuses to publish a key universe, or to judge documentation against one, while any finding stands. ⛔ They are not a second defect and ⛔ must not be chased separately. Clearing the two findings clears all four.

## The disposition, sent to the implementer — the two halves are NOT the same kind of problem

**① `PALETTE_PLACEHOLDER_BLOCKS` — mechanical. Declare it.** Measured by this seat on `origin/main` against the generated `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`, with an **exact whole-token** instrument (`grep -x -F` over the file's sorted unique quoted tokens — **649** of them, which matches the derived count exactly):

| token | count |
|---|---|
| `'nav:menu'` · `'nav:breadcrumb'` · `'global:search'` · `'ai:suggestion'` | 1 each |
| `'protocol-placeholder:nav:menu'` | 1 |
| **[LIT CTRL]** `'field:user'` | 1 |
| **[ABSENT CTRL]** `'nav:zzznosuch'` | 0 |

⇒ all four of that collection's keys are **already in the universe**, under both the bare and the `protocol-placeholder:` spelling — they arrive via the sibling `PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS` registration in the same file, which the table already names and which shares `registerPlaceholder`. So declaring the collection should be a **no-op on the derived universe**, moving no accept set and keeping `Clause-②: no`. ⚠️ The implementer verifies that itself and makes the no-op a measured claim with its control; if the key count **does** move, it stops and reports, because then the accept set widens and the Clause-② answer changes.

⚠️ Recorded because it nearly went the other way: this seat's first probe was `git grep -c -F "'nav:menu'"`, which read **1** — an instrument that ⛔ **cannot distinguish the bare key from the substring inside `'protocol-placeholder:nav:menu'`**. A step was taken on that before it was re-drawn exact. ⭐ A count is not a reading until the instrument can tell apart the thing being asked about.

**② `RETIRED_FIELD_TYPES` — the decision. ⛔ Not made here.** `'field:owner'` reads **0** on the same exact instrument, against a lit control of `'field:user'` at 1 and an absent control at 0 — objectui#9717's defect, confirmed.

The gate's own message names the second legitimate outcome: 「Declare the collection, or **decide deliberately that its keys stay out — but not by silence**」. ⇒ an **explicit, card-referencing exemption**. It keeps today's behaviour byte-for-byte — the key stays out, which objectui#9717 says is correct today but *by accident* — and converts a silence into a **declared, reviewable** state. ⭐ That is not the product call; it is exactly what the card asked for: the silence ends and the question becomes visible instead of buried.

⛔ The product question — whether a retired tombstone spelling belongs in a universe whose job is 「does this string name a component that exists」 — **stays open on objectui#9717**, which is why this PR carries `Part of` and ⛔ not a closing keyword.

## ⛔ What will not happen to get this green

No finding is silenced, no check is skipped, weakened or quarantined, no `field:owner` is hand-added to `INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS` — that would be the 133rd hand-kept entry, and the hand-kept table is what objectui#9703 was filed about in the first place. ⛔ And no re-run: this is not a flake, it is a true report.

⭐ The alignment surfaced **two** silences where the card knew of one. That is a better result than the card asked for, and it is why this PR is red rather than quietly green.

### ⚠️ Correction to the table above — appended at 2026-09-17T20:16Z, a clock read by this edit

**「four red rows」 above is WRONG, and it is understated.** At the time of that write three rows were red; the reading on the same head `3ecbe63669` is now **4 non-green with 1 shard still pending**:

| check | site |
|---|---|
| `Doc Component Type Check` | the gate itself |
| `Test (shard 1/4)` | `check-prompt-component-keys.test.ts:278`, `known-schema-types-derivation-5115.test.ts:53` and `:168` |
| `Test (shard 2/4)` | `examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx:1082` — ⚠️ a FIFTH door, not named above |
| `Test (shard 3/4)` | `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts:1480` — the script's OWN suite, a SIXTH door; same findings array, same two entries |
| `Test (shard 4/4)` | `scripts/__tests__/registry-bare-name-collisions.test.ts:70` — a SEVENTH door; `expected 2 to be +0` |

⛔ The diagnosis is unchanged and the fix is unchanged: **every one of these is the same two `uncovered-indirect-collection` findings**, each failure carrying that message verbatim. What was wrong was treating the red set as a **closed list of four**.

⭐ The correct statement is mechanical rather than enumerated: **every suite that consumes the derivation refuses while any finding stands**, so the red set is however many consumers exist — its size is a fact about the **consumer count**, ⛔ not about the defect. Counting doors was the wrong instrument for the question 「is this one root cause」; the right one is reading each failure's own message.

⇒ ⛔ Do not read 「four go green」 as done. The finish line is **zero findings**, at which point every consumer goes green together.

**Final reading, all shards complete, head `3ecbe63669` at 2026-09-17T20:19Z** — **5 non-green** (`Doc Component Type Check` + all four `Test` shards), spanning **7 distinct assertion sites**, every one of them carrying the same two `uncovered-indirect-collection` entries verbatim. ⛔ Nothing else is red. ⭐ Seven doors, one defect — the count measures how many consumers this derivation has, ⛔ not how much is wrong.

**ACCEPT** — card objectui#9717, reviewed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat at 2026-09-17T21:52Z. Enqueueing. ⚠️ The card **stays open**: this PR carries `Part of`, and the product question it names is ⛔ not answered here.

⛔ Nothing below is taken from the dev's report. The three conditions I set on the dedupe were checked against the **diff and the pin**, ⛔ not against the claim that they were met.

## ① The dedupe must not mask a real collision — **pinned, with the case that must SURVIVE**

This was the dangerous one: a change to how a **gate counts** can be a weakening wearing a bug fix's clothes. Two things satisfy it, and the second is the one I insisted on:

**By construction** — the pass key is `JSON.stringify([entry.site, entry.namespace])`, so two entries on one `site` under **different** namespaces produce different keys and both survive. ⭐ The namespace is *in* the key; masking a genuine two-namespace collision is not expressible.

**By pin** — both halves are asserted, and the surviving half exists:

| case | asserts |
|---|---|
| `⛔ counts a claim ONCE when two entries share a site and a namespace` | 3 distinct `fullType`s, every claimant id unique, `indirectClaims` **= 3** |
| ⭐ `still counts BOTH when two entries share a site under different namespaces` | both namespaces present — `['proto', 'ui']` |

⇒ a case that **must survive**, not only one that must collapse. That was the condition, and it is met by an assertion rather than by an argument.

## ② and ③ — attributed readings, and ⛔ said to be attributed

The flip count and the verdict tally are **runtime** readings from an ablation of the dedupe. ⚠️ Re-running them needs an installed workspace; the shared checkout has none, and a probe there returns a **dead-instrument zero** — ⛔ so none was taken and none is offered as agreement.

What this seat **can** check is internal consistency, and it checks three independent ways:

| reading (attributed) | consistency check |
|---|---|
| `sole` 177 → 206, `agreed` 59 → 30 | **+29 / −29** — the same 29 moving between exactly two buckets, ⭐ and it is the 29 named in advance |
| `contested` 1, `declined` 111 — **unmoved in both states** | the negative control on the same instrument: a change that moved unrelated buckets would be a different change |
| claims 554 → 425 (**−129**), indirect claims 258 → 129 (**−129**) | the entire reduction is the **indirect** half — exactly what a dedupe of indirect entries must produce, and ⛔ not a restatement of the first figure |

⇒ accepted as **corroborated**, ⛔ not as re-measured, and the distinction is on the record rather than blurred.

## ④ The WITHHELD disposition — it ends the silence without answering the question

`RETIRED_FIELD_TYPES` gets a first-class `excluded` disposition, and it does the three things that make it a declaration rather than a mute button:

- its docblock says in terms 「⛔ It is not a way to quiet a finding」, and names the silence objectui#9717 was filed about
- it names **objectui#9717** and states **what dropping the line changes** — 「DROP this `excluded` line …」 — so whoever answers the product question finds the switch
- ⭐ it is **printed in the run summary**: `…, ${counters.withheld} collection(s) declared and WITHHELD)`. An exclusion that can sink out of view is a silence with extra steps; this one reports itself on every run.

`PALETTE_PLACEHOLDER_BLOCKS` is declared as an ordinary entry. **[LIT CTRL]** `PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS` still resolves 5 times in the same file; **[ABSENT CTRL]** 0.

## ⑤ The forks that did not fire, and why that matters

Three stop-and-report conditions were set. ⛔ None fired, and each was measured rather than assumed: the universe still derives **649** keys with the sorted lists diffing clean and a lit control (one key deleted) reporting a difference; `field:owner` reads **0** with lit control `field:user` at 1 and absent control `field:zzznosuch` at 0; `regenerate-known-schema-types --check` prints OK.

⭐ One printed counter **does** move — the summary's indirect figure, 132 → 136 — and it is ⛔ **not** a key count: it counts collection MEMBER NAMES, and the four `PALETTE_PLACEHOLDER_BLOCKS` members are also `PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS` members. **Counted twice, published once.** That the implementer surfaced this rather than letting a moving number pass as a key change is the same discipline this card is about.

## ⑥ Scope — the double-count repair belongs here, and the reasoning is on the record

This PR carries a second gate's repair (`check-registry-bare-name-collisions.mjs`), which I ruled **in scope**: the double-count is ⛔ not a pre-existing defect being swept up, it is **what this diff introduces** — a second `INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS` entry on one `site`. ⭐ Repairing what your own change breaks is finishing, ⛔ not widening. And the shape is this card's thesis a third time: that gate attributes by `entry.site` while coverage is keyed by collection — the same file-vs-collection mismatch, one gate over.

## ⑦ Gates

All **33** check runs on head `bbbdf35faf`: **0 non-green**. ⚠️ Named because partial green would not have been progress: `Doc Component Type Check` and **all four** `Test` shards are green together — that one root cause reached **seven** assertion sites, so anything less than all seven would have been a different failure, not partial success.

⭐ Recorded from the implementer, because the gate caught it and not the author: writing a separator through an editing tool materialised a **real NUL byte** on disk; `check-control-bytes.mjs` exited 1 and named it. The pass key is the repo's own `JSON.stringify` idiom now, and every changed file scans clean.

## ⛔ Why this card does NOT close

The PR carries `Part of`. What remains is the **product question** objectui#9717 names and this diff deliberately declines: does a **retired tombstone spelling** belong in a universe whose job is 「does this string name a component that exists」? ⭐ The alignment made that question **visible and declared** instead of buried in a keying mismatch — which is what the card asked for. Answering it is a maintainer's call.
